situation.zh: 餐馆服务员给你放下一杯冰水。天气很冷，你想换成热水；服务员回来准备为你点单。
situation.en: A restaurant server puts down a glass of iced water. The weather is cold and you want hot water instead; the server returns to take your order.

npc.persona: A restaurant server taking orders. Friendly, attentive, and willing to replace a drink when the customer explains.

hit: Hot water instead of ice water? Of course. I will change it.
Yes, I will bring you a cup of hot water. Careful when it arrives.
partial: You want a drink? Tell me again?

slots.zh_hint: 说明你的状态,让对方理解为什么要热的

reference_answer: I am cold. Can I have some hot water?

provenance.rationale: 餐馆或酒店默认提供冷水时主动要求热水，是中文母语学习者在跨文化旅行中高复用的真实请求。NPC 只询问点单，没有主动猜测换水需求；玩家必须明确说 hot water，单说 water 会保留歧义。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 1 层;water#322 / drink#655 / cold#867 / hot#885 确在最低频段,但 warm#1021 / tea#1599 / freezing#1856 在其后,thirsty 不在 NGSL 内;新增的是形容词 + 名词的修饰结构,是幼儿级的合理增量。
